All three schemas' f0_binding declares the measured canonical F0 (276009f4) and the measured supplement (c8e979a1); schemas/taxonomy_cases.jsonl is the only corpus still off the declared F0.

schemas/taxonomy_cases.jsonl still binds F0 565a6e50/72d12c83, not the declared canonical 276009f4 (owned by astra-life03-repin-claims); schemas/f1_falsifier_tests.jsonl is current at F1 9a8bd4c9.

WARN: the two F0 artifacts use different conclusion-type vocabularies (strong_cosmic_censorship_C0 vs scc_c0_future_inextendibility). Normalized comparison finds no contradiction under the mapping declared in the script, but no shared machine-readable vocabulary exists across the two artifacts.

Policy question left to the controller: the rev26 measurements support 'two different artifacts' (REC-1), while the canonical-path policy still requires byte-identical publication before verdicts bind. This audit measures bytes and does not adjudicate REC-1 vs REC-2.
